title: Etanercept Withdrawal And Retreament Study In Subjects With Nr-ax SpA
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study the benefits and risks of etanercept withdrawal in patients who have achieved a significant clinical response.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of axial SpA duration of symptoms \>3 months and \<5 years back pain with a less than favorable response to NSAIDs

Exclusion Criteria:

* radiological sacroiliitis previous treatment with TNF inhibitor, biologic, immunosuppressive
